description: Returns the full record for one beneficial insect, microbe, or friend-not-foe invertebrate from the bundled 200+ entry beneficial insects fixture (Xerces Society, Cornell Cooperative Extension biocontrol fact sheets, UC IPM Natural Enemies Gallery, UF/IFAS Featured Creatures, USDA-ARS sources). The response is a composite intelligence shape with: identification cues, garden role, habitat needs, the plants that attract this beneficial, the crops it protects via prey relationships (aggregated from preyOn into affected crops), and concrete protection tips. Categories covered: `predator`, `parasitoid`, `pollinator`, `decomposer`, `microbial-control`. Use this when the question is 'what is this insect?' and the answer is a beneficial. Use `get_pest_intelligence` when the answer is a pest. Use `get_verdict` to classify first without committing to a tool.

slug.description: Kebab-case beneficial insect slug. Examples: `seven-spotted-ladybug`, `braconid-wasp-cotesia-congregata`, `common-eastern-bumblebee`, `mason-bee-pure-green`, `mealybug-destroyer`, `bt-kurstaki`. Use `list_beneficials` to discover slugs.

name: get_beneficial_insect
title: Full Detail for a Beneficial Insect or Microbial Control
